sources.entry: docmost Community Edition - Collaborative wiki and documentation software (alternative to Confluence, Notion). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker/Nodejs
Docmost | Collaborative wiki and documentation software

summary.one_liner: Docmost is open-source collaborative wiki and documentation software, offered as a cloud service or self-hosted, with an AGPL-3.0 core and an enterprise edition for some features.
summary.what_it_does: Docmost is a collaborative wiki and documentation platform. The README lists real-time collaboration, spaces, permissions management, groups, comments, page history, search, and file attachments. It supports diagrams via Draw.io, Excalidraw, and Mermaid, plus embeds from services such as Airtable, Loom, and Miro. The interface is translated into 10+ languages. The README points to documentation for getting started and offers a cloud version as an alternative to self-hosting.
use_cases: team wiki and internal knowledge base
organizing docs into spaces with permissions
embedding external content like Airtable or Miro in pages
how_to_run: Refer to the official Docmost documentation for installation and setup
Or try the hosted cloud version
See the development documentation in the repository for contributing or building from source
notable: Built-in diagram support for Draw.io, Excalidraw, and Mermaid
Spaces with groups and permissions management
caveats: Some features (in ee directories) are under a separate Enterprise license rather than AGPL-3.0
README does not detail installation steps; it defers to external documentation
summary.license: AGPL-3.0 (core); Enterprise license for files in apps/server/src/ee, apps/client/src/ee, and packages/ee
